read_me_first.headline: Stance: RISK OFF. SPY is above its 10- and 20-day lines, above a rising 5-day line, and the weekly test agrees — the index is in an uptrend.
because: SPY is above its 10- and 20-day lines, above a rising 5-day line, and the weekly test agrees — the index is in an uptrend.
SPY sits 1.66 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). QQQ sits 2.92 ATRs above its 50-day line (not stretched). VIX/VIX3M is 0.87 — neither calm nor stressed.
Real leadership this week: Cybersecurity, Enterprise Software, Biotech — strong on both the weekly and monthly read.
read_me_first.so_what: Breadth is against the tape — build the watchlist, do not push new entries.
read_me_first.note: Rule-based reading, not a prediction — see docs/AQE_VALEN_DASHBOARD_PROPOSAL.md.

gex.commentary: Just above flip: fragile. A small drop enters the wild zone.
gex.assumption: Customers are long calls and long puts, so dealers are long call gamma and short put gamma. This is the standard convention, NOT observed data — exchange feeds publish open interest, never who is on which side.
gex.dealer_read: Calm market — dealers are long gamma and dampen moves (price tends to pin): support ~770, breakdown level ~777 (losing it turns the market volatile), resistance ~790.

neighbourhood: On both the week and month lists (real leadership): Cybersecurity, Enterprise Software, Biotech, Gaming Streaming, Payments
Leading from their own highs, not just bouncing: Mag7, Enterprise Software, Cloud Computing, Biotech, Cybersecurity
Strong numbers but still well off their highs (a bounce, not leadership yet): Oil Services, Payments, Gaming Streaming, Defense Tech, Critical Minerals
